standard_projective_geometry_sources.author: Adrien Deloro
standard_projective_geometry_sources.title: Affine and Projective Geometry
standard_projective_geometry_sources.supported_fact: For any projective line lambda in P^2(F), deleting lambda gives an affine plane isomorphic to A^2(F); equivalently an arbitrary projective line can serve as the line at infinity.

standard_projective_geometry_sources.author: Joseph Malkevitch
standard_projective_geometry_sources.title: From Affine to Projective Planes and Back
standard_projective_geometry_sources.supported_fact: Projective completion sends each affine parallel class to a common point at infinity, with the points at infinity lying on one projective line; in homogeneous coordinates distinct projective lines meet in a unique point.

cert_side_derived_step: For a finite arrangement and compact union K of finitely many selected bounded triangular-face closures, choose a candidate new infinity line from a direction avoiding the finitely many arrangement directions, then translate it to avoid both the finitely many finite pair-intersection points and K. Standard affinization then makes all pair intersections finite while the selected compact cells remain in the affine chart.

zero_context_corroboration.finding: The zero-context return independently rederived the exact projective-normalization statement and its finite-avoidance/compactness proof, but MATHCERT does not infer reserved independence merely from the agent label or relay identity.

eligibility_use: The published sources supply independent verification of the projective/affine facts on which PREM-001 rests. The exact finite-avoidance consequence is rederived in REVIEW.md and separately corroborated by WP07. Producer-side checker output is not used as authority.
claim_boundary: External support for PREM-001 only. This record does not certify the claim by itself and does not establish preservation of the total bounded-triangle count under a chart change.
